title: Send Out Your Light and Your Truth

questions.question: Vindicate me, O God, and defend my cause against an ungodly what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:1 (ESV): "Vindicate me, O God, and defend my cause against an ungodly people,"

questions.question: From the deceitful and unjust man deliver whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:1 (ESV): "...from the deceitful and unjust man deliver me!"

questions.question: For you are the God in whom I take what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:2 (ESV): "For you are the God in whom I take refuge;"

questions.question: Send out your light and your truth; let them do what to me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:3 (ESV): "Send out your light and your truth; let them lead me;"

questions.question: Let them bring me to your holy hill and to your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:3 (ESV): "let them bring me to your holy hill and to your dwelling!"

questions.question: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:4 (ESV): "Then I will go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy,"

questions.question: I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:4 (ESV): "...and I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God."

questions.question: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:5 (ESV): "Why are you cast down, O my soul... Hope in God;"

questions.question: For I shall again praise him, my salvation and my what?
Why have you rejected me? Why do I go about mourning because of the oppression of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:2 (ESV): "...Why do I go about mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"

questions.question: This Psalm is widely considered to be a continuation of which Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42 and 43 share the same refrain and themes, and are often treated as a single unit.

questions.question: Does Psalm 43 have a title in the Hebrew text?
questions.explanation: Unlike most neighboring Psalms, Psalm 43 has no title, supporting the idea it belongs with Psalm 42.

questions.question: The psalmist asks for God to defend his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:1 (ESV): "...and defend my cause against an ungodly people,"

questions.question: Where does the psalmist wish to be led?
options: To your holy hill and to your dwelling
questions.correctAnswer: To your holy hill and to your dwelling

questions.question: What instrument is mentioned in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalm 43:4 (ESV): "...and I will praise you with the lyre, O God, my God."

key_verse_text: Send out your light and your truth; let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy hill and to your dwelling!
